data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error in the qwen model (HTTP 400 BadRequestError during PKGBUILD review), not by substantive disagreement about package safety. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to complete PKGBUILD review due to HTTP 400 BadRequestError - this is a tool error, not a coverage gap in file selection
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be distinguished from substantive security findings - they should not trigger escalation audits when another model successfully completed the review
